description: Source code for ECUEditorMenuBar class, which defines a GUI menu bar for an ECU editor application, including menu items for settings, image comparison, conversion, and about dialog, with associated action handling.

classes.name: ECUEditorMenuBar
classes.description: A menu bar component for the ECU editor GUI, providing menu items for settings, image comparison, conversion, and about information, with action handling.

methods.name: updateMenu
methods.description: Updates the menu items' enabled/disabled state based on current application state.

methods.name: actionPerformed
methods.description: Handles user actions on menu items, performing tasks like showing properties, opening settings, comparing images, changing user level, and showing about dialog.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves the currently selected ROM image to a file.

methods.name: getImageOutputFile
methods.description: Displays a file save dialog for the user to choose where to save the image.

methods.name: writeImage
methods.description: Writes byte array data to the specified file and updates application state.

methods.name: getRepositoryOutputDir
methods.description: Displays a directory chooser for saving repository data.

methods.name: saveAsRepository
methods.description: Saves ROM tables into a selected repository directory.

methods.name: increaseRomSize
methods.description: Converts the ROM image to a larger size (160KB to 192KB).

methods.name: decreaseRomSize
methods.description: Converts the ROM image to a smaller size (192KB to 160KB).

methods.name: getLastSelectedRomFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the last selected ROM.
